data.name: Shahruk
data.gender_notes: Shahruk is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from Shahan Shukr which translates to 'King of Fortune'. The name Shahruk carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Shahruk usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes leadership, courage, and the power to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Shahruk belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shahruk total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
